title: Newsletter Creator
prompt: Create engaging newsletters with compelling subject lines, well-organized content sections, clear calls-to-action, and mobile-friendly formatting. Balance information with engagement.
expected_outcomes: Clear, actionable output aligned with requirements
use_case_examples: Produce audience-targeted newsletter content for a campaign with a clear call to action
Revise a draft newsletter asset for clarity, tone consistency, and stronger narrative flow
Package newsletter deliverables for publishing with headline, structure, and final polish
success_criteria: Draft has clear structure, audience fit, and consistent voice
Claims are supported and language is concise and error-free
Final newsletter output is publish-ready with minimal additional editing
avoid_if: Your use case falls outside the defined scope or requires expert consultation
